title: Headless command lifetime is configured before launch
verification: Claude launch environment declares BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS and BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS set to the longest wrapper duration through the shared native environment builder. A foreground timeout does not extend moved background lifetime. Explicit background calls set their own timeout; subagents inherit the process setting and use foreground Bash. Codex and Cursor defer this Claude-only setting because no equivalent limit is documented. Released relay wait evidence is still required. Monitor defaults to five minutes and caps at thirty minutes interactively or ten minutes for text-prompt headless runs, independent of plan. Rearm the same tail after its effective expiry; durable tool-call deadlines govern duplicate refusal.
